channel.title: Second Act by Brightfront Studio
channel.description: Starting and running a small business after 40

item.title: How to get your first customer reviews (without feeling awkward)
item.description: When and how to ask for your first customer reviews, polite wording you can copy, how to reply to a bad review calmly, and the rules you must never break.

item.title: How much does it really cost to start a small business? A plain-English breakdown
item.description: One-off and monthly start-up costs explained simply, with typical ranges for a service business and a shop, the costs people forget, and how to start lean.

item.title: How to build a simple website for your small business (without hiring a developer)
item.description: A plain-English guide to building a simple small business website yourself: the four pages you need, builder vs WordPress, domains, what to write and costs.

item.title: How to write a simple business plan (one page is enough)
item.description: No 30-page document needed. How to write a one-page business plan for a small business after 40, with a template, an example and simple break-even maths.

item.title: How to start a business after 40: a calm, step-by-step guide
item.description: A practical, no-hype guide to starting a business in your 40s, 50s or 60s: choosing an idea, testing it cheaply, money, paperwork and your first customers.

item.title: Is 50 too old to start a business? An honest answer
item.description: Thinking about starting a business at 50 or 60? The real advantages, the real risks, and how to decide whether it makes sense for you, without hype.

item.title: 25 side business ideas for people over 40, using skills you already have
item.description: 25 realistic side business ideas for people in their 40s, 50s and 60s, grouped by the skills you already have, with start-up costs, pros and cons for each.

item.title: How to turn your career experience into a consulting business
item.description: Leaving a corporate or public-sector job? Turn decades of experience into a consulting business: choose a niche, package your offer, set fees and find clients.

item.title: How to start a side business without quitting your job
item.description: A realistic plan for building a side business on evenings and weekends: finding the time, staying on the right side of your employer, and knowing when to leave.

item.title: How to get your first 10 customers (without being pushy)
item.description: A practical, low-pressure plan for finding the first customers for a new small business: your network, referrals, local visibility, reviews and follow-up.

item.title: How to price your services when you're just starting out
item.description: A plain-English method for pricing a new service business: work out your minimum rate, check the market, price on value, and raise prices with confidence.

item.title: How to set up a Google Business Profile: a step-by-step guide for non-tech people
item.description: Set up your free Google Business Profile so customers find you on Google Search and Maps. Plain-English steps to sign up, verify, add photos and get reviews.

item.title: How to use AI in your small business: a beginner's guide (no tech skills needed)
item.description: A plain-English guide to AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot for small business owners: what they do well, prompts and mistakes to avoid.

item.title: 10 scams that target new small business owners, and how to spot them
item.description: New business owners are a favourite scam target. The 10 most common small business scams, from fake domain renewals to invoice fraud, and how to stay safe.
